premises.text: City leaders lack usable data because it is trapped in silos, legacy systems, spreadsheets, and paper
premises.evidence_span: the data is trapped in silos

premises.text: A modular governance platform pulls legacy-system data into reports and actionable insights aligned to city services
premises.evidence_span: We take data from any existing legacy system and produce reports and actionable insights that governments can use to reach their goals

premises.text: A client-side data bridge queries legacy databases daily and paper records can be digitized as a service
premises.evidence_span: The data bridge is a standalone part of our software that is installed on the client server

premises.text: SaaS pricing uses a one-time setup fee plus annual module licenses sized to win contracts below procurement thresholds
premises.evidence_span: Our modular pricing helps winning contracts below procurement thresholds

premises.text: Go-to-market scales via regional sales teams, political networks, and social proof starting in Germany then Europe
premises.evidence_span: we want to scale to other European markets soon

value.text: Data-empowered decisions that make local government more effective and efficient for citizens
value.evidence_span: all city leaders across Europe make data-empowered decisions, improving the life of millions of their citizens

causal_links.evidence_span: when it comes to decision-making local governments tap in the dark
produce reports and actionable insights that governments can use to reach their goals
we scale through political networks and social proof

notes: Childcare module demo treated as illustration of the modular platform, not a separate premise. Competitive contrasts folded into product positioning. Paying-customer counts excluded as traction. Anti-template: data problem, product integration, and GTM/pricing separately revisable.
